productImportRules: Extract only facts supported by the supplied page, documents, pictures, or pasted notes.
Leave unknown grams, print hours, packaging, design time, and target price at zero and ask for review.
Preserve the source URL and source names in product notes.
Treat MakerWorld, Etsy, and any other public product page as source material, not as authority for internal costs.
jobPlanStages: Produce a prototype or proof when appropriate
Get customer approval before the full run
listingRules: Do not claim certifications, compatibility, safety, durability, or performance that the source does not support.
Write clear titles and descriptions for the selected platform.
Call out personalization choices, included quantity, material, dimensions, and limitations when known.
Avoid keyword stuffing and keep every tag relevant.
